name: Crystal Cove Fire Ecology High School Internship
what_you_do: Work with scientists and land managers to study how fire changes Orange County land. You look at plants, wildlife and soil. You also learn about jobs in science and land care.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 9 to 12 who go to high school in Orange County.
duration: October 2026 to May 2027. Saturday field days and a one hour Zoom on Wednesday afternoons.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 deadline was Sept 13, 2026. Applications are closed. Dates for next year are not posted.
how_to_apply: Check the program page for the next round. Questions: Brent Castanon, brent@crystalcove.org, or 949.376.6200.
notes: These are last year's dates. Next year's dates are not posted yet. Partners are California State Parks, Irvine Ranch Conservancy and UC Irvine. The program page says this year's dates could still change.
